description: Quantitative crypto backtesting & Bitcoin market-regime analytics. 73 MCP tools: honest look-ahead-aware backtest validation with Deflated-Sharpe-Ratio correction, point-in-time 10-indicator Bitcoin cycle scoring, macro-regime composites, Edge-Library filter effects, 22 on-chain BRK series (since 2009), altcoin screener, sentiment, "buy now or wait?" decision-math, conditional historical-analog base rates & live subscriptions. Core outputs are not reproducible from public OHLCV/market-data APIs. Covers crypto plus stocks/ETFs/commodities/forex. Free tier, no credit card.
